description: Send the person's answers for an application Sam Alishahi started. Only send what the person told you or confirmed; leave unknown fields out. Returns the updated application with any rejected answers and why.

answers.description: Answers keyed by field name from get_application. Select fields take one of their choices; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

notes.description: Anything else the person wants Sam to know.

submit.description: True when the person is done, even if optional fields are blank.

name: complete_application
title: Add answers to an application
